description: This source file defines the Aws\ElasticsearchService\ElasticsearchServiceClient class, which is a client used to interact with the Amazon Elasticsearch Service via AWS SDK for PHP. It contains method declarations with annotations indicating their purposes, including both synchronous and asynchronous versions.

classes.name: ElasticsearchServiceClient
classes.description: A client class extending AwsClient to interact with Amazon Elasticsearch Service, providing methods for various actions like creating, deleting, describing domains, and managing clusters.

methods.name: addTags
methods.description: Adds tags to an Elasticsearch domain.

methods.name: associatePackage
methods.description: Associates a package with a domain.

methods.name: authorizeVpcEndpointAccess
methods.description: Authorizes access to a VPC endpoint.

methods.name: cancelElasticsearchServiceSoftwareUpdate
methods.description: Cancels a software update for Elasticsearch service.

methods.name: createOutboundCrossClusterSearchConnection
methods.description: Creates an outbound cross-cluster search connection.

methods.name: deleteElasticsearchServiceRole
methods.description: Deletes the service role for Elasticsearch.

methods.name: deleteInboundCrossClusterSearchConnection
methods.description: Deletes an inbound cross-cluster search connection.

methods.name: deleteOutboundCrossClusterSearchConnection
methods.description: Deletes an outbound cross-cluster search connection.

methods.name: describeDomainChangeProgress
methods.description: Describes the progress of a domain change.

methods.name: describeElasticsearchDomainConfig
methods.description: Describes the configuration of an Elasticsearch domain.

methods.name: describeElasticsearchInstanceTypeLimits
methods.description: Describes limits for Elasticsearch instance types.

methods.name: dissociatePackage
methods.description: Dissociates a package from a domain.

methods.name: listVpcEndpointsForDomain
methods.description: Lists VPC endpoints for a domain.

methods.name: rejectInboundCrossClusterSearchConnection
methods.description: Rejects an inbound cross-cluster search connection.

methods.name: revokeVpcEndpointAccess
methods.description: Revokes access to a VPC endpoint.

methods.name: updateElasticsearchDomainConfig
methods.description: Updates the configuration of an Elasticsearch domain.
